name: Proof of Profit
summary: Gelinda Coppergleam has found signs of cubic draconia in the caves, but needs a crystal to prove it exists. She asks you to bring her one so she can show others its worth.

sections.title: A Crystal for Proof
sections.body: Gelinda Coppergleam's surveying tools show signs of a new mineral in the caves, which she calls cubic draconia. Readings alone will not convince people, so she asks you to bring back a crystal as proof. Dragons are in the caves, and Gelinda says there may be crystals showing through the dirt.

faq.answer: Gelinda Coppergleam has found signs of cubic draconia in the caves using her surveying tools.
Cubic draconia is a mineral Gelinda believes she has found in the caves.

faq.q: Why does Gelinda want a crystal?
faq.answer: Gelinda wants a crystal to prove that cubic draconia exists, since people prefer to see one rather than inspect her readings.

faq.q: Where can I find cubic draconia?
faq.answer: Gelinda says there may be crystals showing through the dirt in the caves.

faq.q: Are there dragons in the caves?
faq.answer: Yes. Gelinda warns that dragons are in the caves.

faq.q: What if I can't get a crystal out?
faq.answer: Gelinda offers to lend you dynamite if you have trouble getting cubic draconia out of the ground.

angles.text: As a miner, you can bring Gelinda Coppergleam a cubic draconia crystal to prove the mineral exists.

attribution: In-game quest text: Proof of Profit
